title: Landing y catálogo público
brief: Landing page for an Apple products store in Argentina (es-AR), with a family entry point, a product grid and — in two of the three directions — the product-detail treatment with a capacity selector. All prices are sample data rendered in ARS.

artboards.title: Galería
artboards.tradeoff: Centred, quiet, most faithful to Apple's product pages; type and whitespace carry the page, but it is the least information-dense and a six-item grid hides the other 58 products

artboards.title: Índice
artboards.tradeoff: A readable catalog with a numbered family index and wide rows that compare at a glance, and the capacity price ladder outside the PDP; less dramatic, reads closer to an editorial catalog than to Apple

artboards.title: Vitrina
artboards.tradeoff: Dark floor with each product in a lit case and a segmented capacity configurator in the detail; the strongest premium pull, the hardest place to keep retail prices legible and the furthest from a familiar Argentine store
